session.description: overnight: the US day market (Blue Ocean ATS, 20:00-04:00 New York time before the trading day it belongs to), served apart from the other sessions (ADR 0030).

reason.description: fixture_missing: a synthetic fixture has no bar; not_available_as_of_cutoff: published after the cutoff; provider_no_bar: the provider reported no bar (normally no trades in that minute on the feed); outside_entitlement: the plan does not allow this range yet (e.g. the latest 15 minutes of SIP on a free plan); not_yet_final: too recent for an absent bar to be treated as no trades. session_not_covered: the source does not provide this session (e.g. a broker feed confirmed for regular hours only). beyond_source_history: older than this source can serve (e.g. a broker returning only the latest 40 bars).

currency.description: USD for US listings, KRW for Korean (kr:) listings.
USD for US listings, KRW for Korean (kr:) listings.

asserted_at_utc.description: When the server recorded the user's assertion.

selected_interval_start_utc.description: Candle the user clicked: context only, never the execution time.

executed_at_utc.description: User-claimed execution time; null only when time_precision is unknown. Independent of the selected interval.

currency.description: USD for US listings, KRW for Korean (kr:) listings.

fee_assumption.description: Total fees for the round trip.

slippage_assumption.description: Adverse price slippage per share, applied at entry and at exit.

account_ref.description: Broker ledger only: the broker account this FIFO book belongs to. Accounts are never netted against each other.

fees_unreported_count.description: Executions without reported fees (Kiwoom): realized P&L and fees leave their fees out. Absent when every fee is known.

ImportedExecution.description: A fill read from a user-supplied broker statement file. Not API-verified.

currency.description: USD for US listings, KRW for Korean (kr:) listings.

CredentialSummary.description: A registered provider key as shown to the user. Secret values and full account numbers are never part of this contract.

environment.description: Whether a broker key belongs to a real (실전) or a demo (모의투자) account; null for vendor keys, which are not per account.

active.description: The key's provider is the running market-data provider.

SessionListResponse.description: Consecutive trading sessions ending at end_date (inclusive), oldest first.

SymbolSearchResponse.description: US-listed stocks matching a ticker or company-name query, from the provider's symbol directory. Any result can be charted with the active provider.

fetched_at_utc.description: When the directory was last fetched from the provider.

stale.description: The directory is older than a day and could not be refreshed; results may miss new listings.

local_name.description: Korean display name from Toss, when a Toss key is registered and Toss has one.

MarketQuote.description: A point-in-time quote read on demand from a broker: last price, order book, recent trades and daily price limits. Not stored; prices are exact decimal strings and times UTC.

observed_at_utc.description: When this API read the quote.

StockInfo.description: A broker's reference data for one stock and its active buying warnings, read on demand.

ExchangeRate.description: A broker's reference (display) exchange rate for one minute-long window; actual trades may use a different rate.

BrokerMarketCalendar.description: A broker's market hours for the previous, current and next business day, compared with the local exchange calendar where one exists. Closed sessions are absent.

agrees.description: Whether the local calendar the charts use has the same bounds; null when there is no local session to compare.

ResearchTable.description: A broker research table for reading (rankings, market indicators, sectors, Korean trading trends). Values are exact strings as the broker sent them, times are UTC, nested fields are dotted column names. Not an input to charts, indicators or backtests.

key.description: The symbol or sector ID the table is about, if any.

next_cursor.description: Value to pass as `until` or `before` for older rows.

fees.description: null when the broker's order history does not report it (Kiwoom); never assumed zero.

commission.description: null when the broker's order history does not report it (Kiwoom); never assumed zero.

tax.description: null when the broker's order history does not report it (Kiwoom); never assumed zero.

currency.description: USD for US listings, KRW for Korean (kr:) listings.

time_meaning.description: reported_last_fill: the broker's filledAt for the order, when its last fill happened (Toss). reported_fill_time: the one fill time the broker reports for the order, without saying whether it is the first or the last fill (Kiwoom cntr_time). Neither is a per-fill time.

granularity.description: One record per order: total filled quantity at the average fill price. The broker reports no individual fills.

BrokerOrderExecution.description: An order's execution as reported by a broker API, read on demand and stored append-only. A separate ledger from manual entries and statement imports; never summed with them.

execution_count.description: All executions in the ledger (or for the instrument); `executions` may list only the newest of them.

time_unresolved.description: Kiwoom: orders whose reported time could not be placed on the order date's US session (04:00-20:00 New York), for example daytime-session orders. Not stored.

conflicts.description: Broker order IDs whose reported execution changed after it was stored; the stored record is kept.

BrokerSyncResult.description: What one on-demand sync of closed broker orders stored.

errors.description: Parts of this account that could not be read; the rest is shown.

BrokerAccountSnapshot.description: A broker account view read on demand: holdings, buying power, commission rates and open orders. Account numbers appear only as their last four digits. Nothing here is stored.

BrokerSellableQuantity.description: How much of one stock a broker account can sell now, read on demand.

RealtimeEvent.description: One event relayed from the broker's realtime stream to the app. Trade and order book frames can be dropped by the broker (no sequence numbers); order events are lossless only within one connection.

oneOf.description: A trade print received from the stream.
A change to one of the user's own orders.
The broker ledger was resynced after an order closed or the stream reconnected.
The relay's connection to the broker.

TickListResponse.description: Trade ticks this app received from a broker stream for one symbol and New York date. Lossy by nature: a received record, never a complete tape, and never an input to bars.

count.description: All stored ticks for the day; `ticks` may hold only the latest of them.

bar_count.description: Bar-count mode: the first N bars from start_date, read forward up to end_date (any past window, not only up to today). Absent: every bar from start_date to end_date.

bar_count_requested.description: Bar-count mode: the number of bars asked for; bar_count is how many were found.

custom_indicators.description: Python indicator versions used by rules operands (ADR 0023), each pinned by its code SHA-256.

ReconciliationLink.description: A pairing with a record of another ledger. Differences compare the counterpart group (summed quantity, quantity-weighted average price) with the broker order.

price_difference_bps.description: Counterpart average price against the broker average price, in basis points.

ReconciliationRecord.description: One record of an actual-fill ledger as the reconciliation classified it. The ledger record itself is unchanged.

time_utc.description: Execution time; for a broker order, its reported last fill (or the order time when none was reported). Null when a manual record's time is unknown.

TradeReconciliationResponse.description: A computed, read-only comparison of the broker API ledger with the manual and statement-import ledgers. Nothing is merged, rewritten or stored.

view.description: Derived on request from the ledgers; never stored.

since_utc.description: Filters the records shown; earlier records still count as counterparts.

record_count.description: All records; `records` may list only the newest of them, while `summary` always counts all.
